title: Gameplay Logic Graph

nodes.title: Player Enters Zone
nodes.description: Fires when the player crosses the encounter boundary.

nodes.title: Check Stamina
nodes.description: Prevents the first pressure spike from hitting during a low-resource state.

nodes.title: Update Quest Objective
nodes.description: Marks the encounter as the active mission step and exposes the objective marker.

nodes.title: Branch Dialogue Bark
nodes.description: Chooses ally, rival, or silent VO based on faction reputation and stealth state.

nodes.title: Spawn Encounter Wave
nodes.description: Spawns readable enemy composition with recovery spacing.

nodes.title: Broadcast AI Behavior Signal
nodes.description: Tells squad AI whether to flank, hold cover, investigate, or retreat.

nodes.title: Set Enemy Reaction State
nodes.description: Switches enemies between alerted, suppressed, vulnerable, or regrouping states.

nodes.title: Combat Reaction Window
nodes.description: Opens the parry, dodge, stagger, or interrupt timing window and logs readability.

nodes.title: Trigger Foundry Hazard
nodes.description: Starts steam vents only after the player has seen the warning light and audio cue.

nodes.title: Start Micro Cinematic
nodes.description: Frames the shortcut unlock without stealing control longer than two seconds.

nodes.title: Select Encounter Variant
nodes.description: Chooses authored spawn, hazard, and reward variants from a fairness-tested pool.

nodes.title: Resolve Outcome
nodes.description: Routes clear, stealth bypass, retreat, or fail-forward to distinct world states.

nodes.title: Calculate Economy Payout
nodes.description: Applies currency, crafting part, durability, and faction-reputation rewards without inflation spikes.

nodes.title: Unlock Progression Node
nodes.description: Unlocks a shortcut, codex entry, skill-tree hint, and optional replay modifier.

nodes.title: Grant Shortcut Reward
nodes.description: Unlocks a shortcut and optional cache after mastery.

edges.condition: wave cleared, bypassed, or player retreats

variables.name: difficultyScalar
variables.notes: Scales enemy count and reward payout.

variables.name: emberCourtReputation
variables.notes: Branches VO, assistance, and payout multipliers.

variables.name: encounterSeed
variables.notes: Locks procedural variants for reproducible playtests.

collaborationNotes.concern: Combat reactions need recovery windows before hazards stack.
collaborationNotes.decision: Hazard trigger waits for an attack commitment and a warning tell.

collaborationNotes.concern: Dialogue bark must reflect faction state without blocking player control.
collaborationNotes.decision: Branch bark is optional and never gates the combat route.
Payout node applies a reward-budget check before unlocks.

critiqueNotes: Every failure route must explain itself to the player through HUD, audio, or animation tells.
Procedural variants must be authored enough to preserve fairness and readable escalation.
